$comment: Packaging manifest for claude.ai-uploadable .skill release assets. Each entry names a skill that is safe to run STANDALONE on claude.ai (no subagent dispatch, no plugin-root scripts) plus the repo-level files its SKILL.md references, which the builder copies into the bundle at the same relative path so in-prose references resolve from the skill root. scripts/build-skill-assets.py consumes this; tests/test_skill_assets.py guards it. A skill whose SKILL.md needs ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} or an undeclared repo file is REJECTED by the builder — add the file here or fix the skill, never ship a broken reference.
